prompt: Build specs.html (HTML with embedded CSS and JS): a comparison table of three laptop models rendered from a JS data object, with an English/Finnish switch. Values per model: weight 1.24 kg, 1.55 kg, 2.1 kg; battery 52 Wh, 72 Wh, 99.5 Wh; storage 512 GB, 1 TB, 2 TB; display 13.6 in, 15.3 in, 16.2 in; battery life up to 18 h, 15 h, 22 h; price 1299 €, 1899 €, 2799 €. Numbers must read correctly in Finnish.
assertions: In the rendered DOM for both English and Finnish, every number-unit pair in the table (weight, battery, storage, display, battery life, price) is joined by U+00A0 or U+202F, never a plain U+0020
The Finnish rendering uses decimal commas (1,24 and 99,5) and groups the prices with a no-break space (1 299 €)
specs.html sets the numeric cells with tabular-nums
specs.html sets the html lang attribute to fi when Finnish is selected
specs.html uses logical properties for text layout (no margin-left/right, padding-left/right, text-align: left/right, left/right offsets)
In the rendered DOM for both languages, the battery-life qualifier (up to / jopa) is bound to its number with a no-break space, so it cannot be stranded at a line end
